name: Padded negative contrast
hint: State both supported points directly.

name: Restated contrast
hint: Keep the positive claim when both halves say the same thing.

name: Unresolved negative contrast
hint: Check whether both halves add information.

name: Clipped negative tail
hint: Spell out the consequence if the text supports it.

name: Split contrast
hint: Combine the two claims only after checking their relationship.

name: Stock one-line closer
pattern: that is the real win|that distinction matters|read that again|let that sink in|that is the whole point
hint: Remove the line when it only repeats the prior point.

name: Repeated short closer
hint: Keep the useful statement and remove repeated closers.

name: Repeated negative fragments
hint: Join the fragments without changing their claims.

name: All-caps emphasis
hint: Use normal case unless the word is an acronym.

name: Dotted emphasis
hint: Write the phrase without dramatic stops.

name: Announced verdict
hint: Start with the claim instead of announcing a verdict.

name: Inflated framing
pattern: the real question is|what really matters is|the deeper issue is|the heart of the matter is
hint: Use the direct form of the claim.

name: Importance preface
hint: Start with the claim itself.

name: Decorative aphorism
pattern: \bis the (?:language|currency|architecture|grammar) of\b|\bbecomes? a trap\b|\bis not a tool but a mirror\b
hint: Replace the saying only when the text supplies a precise claim.

name: Staged opener
pattern: let's dive in|let's dive into|let's explore|let's break this down|here's what you need to know|now let's look at|without further ado|heads up|quick note|honestly\?|here's the thing|the thing is|let's be honest|real talk|look,
hint: Remove the run-up and keep the point.

name: Unnamed 'part' framing
pattern: the hard part is|the new part is|the part that matters is|the part worth
hint: Name the subject rather than calling it a part.

name: Unprompted defence
pattern: to be clear|don't get me wrong|i'm not saying|i am not saying|this isn't mainly about|this is not to say|some might say|you might think|it would be easy to just
hint: State the supported claim without the defence.

name: Unweighed alternative
pattern: a tempting approach would be|one might be tempted to|an obvious approach would be
hint: Keep the alternative only when the text genuinely weighs it.

name: Three-part sentence
hint: Keep three items when each one is necessary.

name: Three parallel examples
hint: Vary or combine the examples if they make the same point.

name: Repeated sentence openings
hint: Merge a safe pair or vary one opening.

name: Dash connector
hint: Choose a comma, colon, full stop or range marker.

name: Stacked qualifiers
pattern: could potentially|might arguably|may possibly|possibly be argued|in some cases it may|to be fair|it's also possible|it is possible that
hint: Keep the source's level of uncertainty with fewer qualifiers.

name: Post-noun compound hyphen
hint: Remove the hyphen only after the noun.

name: Missing subject before needed
hint: Add the explicit reader subject.

name: Clear passive with actor
hint: Put the named actor first when the grammar is clear.

name: Overused formal word
hint: Use the plain equivalent when this is not a technical sense.

name: Trailing significance claim
hint: Keep the fact and remove an unsupported importance tail.

name: Stock outlook sentence
pattern: the future looks bright|exciting times (?:lie )?ahead|bright future|a step in the right direction
hint: End on the last concrete fact.

name: Stock outlook section
pattern: despite these challenges|continues to thrive|challenges and legacy|future outlook|awards and recognition|evolving landscape|indelible mark|setting the stage for|stands as a testament
hint: Keep the concrete condition and review the broad conclusion.

name: Unspecified relationship
pattern: associated with|in association with|connected to|in connection with|linked to|tied to
hint: Name the relationship only if the source gives it.

name: Abstract trailing -ing clause
hint: Remove the abstract tail when the sentence already contains the fact.

name: Promotional wording
pattern: nestled (?:within|in)|in the heart of|natural beauty|breathtaking|must-visit|stunning|renowned|groundbreaking|profound|vibrant|rich cultural heritage|commitment to|diverse array|exemplifies|featuring
hint: Use a plain description instead of promotional wording.

name: Unnamed or list-based authority
pattern: experts (?:argue|believe|say|note)|observers have cited|industry reports|some critics|several publications|trade publications|independent coverage|over \d[\d,]* followers|active social media presence
hint: Name the source and claim when the text provides them.

name: Long form of is or was
hint: Use the matching form of is when the subject is unambiguous.

name: Long form of has
hint: Use has when possession is the meaning.

name: Decorative bold markers
hint: Keep the words and remove decorative bold markers.

name: Decorative symbol
hint: Remove the symbol while keeping the line.

name: Title-case heading
hint: Use sentence case without changing names or acronyms.

name: Repeated section rule
hint: Let headings separate the sections.

name: Repeated top title
hint: Keep the title once.

name: Curly quotation marks
hint: Use straight quote marks for plain text.

name: Chat wrapper
pattern: great question|of course!|certainly!|you're absolutely right|i hope this helps|let me know if|would you like|want me to|should i continue|here is an overview|here's an overview|here is a summary|here's a summary
hint: Remove the wrapper and keep its content.

name: Source-limit disclaimer
pattern: as of \d{4}|up to my last training update|while specific details (?:are|is) limited|based on available information|not publicly available|not widely documented|not widely disclosed|in the provided sources|in the available sources|it is believed that|maintains a low profile|likely (?:grew up|studied|began)
hint: State only what the cited material establishes.

name: Heading restated below it
hint: Remove the line that merely repeats the heading.

name: Document narration
pattern: was added to replace|generated from|compiled from|the table below|this section is organized|the figures below|anything (?:unconfirmed|we could not confirm) is flagged
hint: Write about the subject unless the process changes what the reader should do.

name: Reply repeats shared context
hint: Review only when the surrounding thread is available.
